title: Merge
description: A human merge of two entities (housamkak v3 §12.6) — one line of llm-wiki/states/merges.jsonl, an append-only ledger written only by the engine's merge verb. merge_id = mrg_ + 12 hex of sha256(from_entity · into_entity). On replay, after alias folding and in ledger order, every mention of from_entity resolves to into_entity, from's name and aliases join into's aliases, and into.merged_from lists from; a chain A→B, B→C resolves A to C. Nothing merges on similarity — graph check proposes, a human disposes. This row is never rewritten: `unmerge <merge_id>` undoes the merge's run through a states/retractions.jsonl row that the replay honors, not by editing or removing this line.

into_entity.description: The surviving entity; must not itself have been merged away.

by.description: The human who judged the pair the same thing.

run_id.description: The run that appended this row (spec.md `### Ledger rows`) — run_ + 12 hex of sha256(actor · verb · timestamp · the input hashes · views_before), the same id stamped on the row's states/audit_log.jsonl entry. Optional: absent on every row from Phases 1–5, present on every row Phase 6 on appends.
